title: MADMADHOUSE poster harvest manifest
description: Written by the Cowork / Claude-in-Chrome harvest session. Consumed by the Claude Code build session. This file plus assets/posters/originals/ is the entire interface between the two sessions.

harvestedAt.description: ISO 8601, when the harvest run finished

postCount.description: Posts the grid reported, for reconciliation against posts[].length

notes.description: Anything the harvest session wants the build session to know

altText.description: The image alt attribute VERBATIM. The strongest extraction signal: it carries transcribed flyer text with @handles inline. null only if the attribute was genuinely absent.

captionText.description: Full caption VERBATIM. Do not trim, translate, or clean.

tempAssetId.description: Shortcode-keyed. Renamed to the real mmh-DATE--venue--NN assetId in Phase 4, once the date is resolved.

mintedAs.description: Real mmh- assetId this image was renamed to by mint_assets.py. Present only after minting; the file on disk is <mintedAs>.jpg, not <tempAssetId>.jpg.

setAside.description: Sibling folder under assets/posters/ this image was deliberately moved to because it is not an event flyer (e.g. '_promo'). The harvest record stays intact; the validator looks for the file there instead of failing.

sourceAccount.description: Set when the post is NOT the harvested account's own: a presenter's or venue's post that documents a night (2026-10-01, the Vadoz Rooftop Afters flyer is @vadozhouse's). Excluded from postCount reconciliation, which counts the account's own grid only.

failures.description: Posts that could not be captured. Recording a failure is required; silently dropping a post is not acceptable, because the build session reconciles against postCount.
